---
title: stat-count
subtitle: "Count statistic: one output row per distinct x level with `y = count`."
category: Stats
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Empty strings and `none` x values are dropped. Output rows preserve the
first-seen order of x levels.

## Usage

```typst
stat-count()
```



## Returns

Statistic object with `name: "count"`, consumed by geom layers.

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/stat-count-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = (
  (grp: "a"),
  (grp: "b"),
  (grp: "a"),
  (grp: "c"),
  (grp: "a"),
)
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "grp"),
  layers: (geom-bar(),),
)
```

## See also

[`geom-bar`](../geoms/geom-bar.qmd), [`stat-bin`](stat-bin.qmd), [`stat-identity`](stat-identity.qmd).
